verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs say it can implement features from prompts and open pull requests, and they list Figma as a connected OAuth integration. That suggests a design-informed path to code. However, nothing documents turning a mockup or Figma design into a working implementation, or how far a non-engineer can get without engineering review. Missing for 10: documented design/mockup-to-code workflow using the Figma integration, evidence of a PM-driven flow from design to deployed implementation without engineer review or merge, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Connect with Slack, Linear, Figma, databases, and extend capabilities with custom MCP tools.
Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
